from tbparse import SummaryReader
import pandas as pd

reader = SummaryReader('logdir/exp_001_baseline_s2')
df = reader.scalars

# Extract the three tags
val = df[df['tag']=='scalars/value_mean'][['step','value']].rename(columns={'value':'value_mean'})
ev = df[df['tag']=='scalars/eval_return'][['step','value']].rename(columns={'value':'eval_return'})
ve = df[df['tag']=='civo/ve_ratio'][['step','value']].rename(columns={'value':'ve_ratio_logged'})

# Merge
merged = val.merge(ev, on='step', how='outer').merge(ve, on='step', how='outer')
merged = merged.sort_values('step')

# Filter step >= 35000
m = merged[merged['step'] >= 35000].copy()

# Compute ve_ratio where both value_mean and eval_return exist
m['ve_ratio_calc'] = m.apply(lambda r: r['value_mean']/r['eval_return'] if pd.notna(r['value_mean']) and pd.notna(r['eval_return']) and r['eval_return'] > 0 else None, axis=1)

print('step,eval_return,value_mean,ve_ratio_logged,ve_ratio_calc')
for _, r in m.iterrows():
    step = int(r['step'])
    ev_str = f\"{r['eval_return']:.2f}\" if pd.notna(r['eval_return']) else ''
    val_str = f\"{r['value_mean']:.2f}\" if pd.notna(r['value_mean']) else ''
    ve_l = f\"{r['ve_ratio_logged']:.6f}\" if pd.notna(r['ve_ratio_logged']) else ''
    ve_c = f\"{r['ve_ratio_calc']:.6f}\" if pd.notna(r['ve_ratio_calc']) else ''
    # Only print rows that have at least eval_return or value_mean
    if ev_str or val_str:
        print(f'{step},{ev_str},{val_str},{ve_l},{ve_c}')
"
